Where it Started:
Rooted in Science.

KPP Pest Management wasn't born from a business plan, but from a scientific pursuit. Founded in 2002, our foundation lies in the depths of the agrochemical industry.

Our founder's tenure as an R&D Manager provided a unique perspective on translating laboratory research into practical pest management strategies. Today, that evidence-based approach continues to guide every treatment and prevention plan we deliver. This expertise enables us to deliver evidence-based solutions that focus not only on eliminating pests, but also on preventing future infestations.
